title: The Mountain Terrace at Woodside

services.name: Team Building
services.desc: When planning your next offsite corporate meeting, product launch or team building activity, we invite you to explore the spectacular redwoods and versatile indoor spaces of The Mountain Terrace. Our rustic venue and warm, personalized approach are the perfect combination to enable you to create that memorable event for your company. A world away from the fast pace of the office, yet conveniently located in the heart of Silicon Valley in Woodside we offer a large outdoor meadow, great for group team building activities and classic dinner parties, along with a quiet indoor space for your business meeting or breakout presentations.
